title: Samsung's Android XR smart glasses hands-on: stylish with good privacy protections like local face redaction and nice Gemini features like real-time translation (Victoria Song/The Verge)
summary: Victoria Song / The Verge: Samsung's Android XR smart glasses hands-on: stylish with good privacy protections like local face redaction and nice Gemini features like real-time translation — It's a weird time to launch a new pair of smart glasses. — These last few years, Meta has been the dominant player in pushing a fragile smart glasses resurgence.
